I have inspected and exercised the skill as fully as is safely possible in this sandbox.

## What the skill is
`civitai-analyst` is a **natural-language-to-SQL analytics skill**. It turns plain-English/Chinese questions about Civitai video performance into PostgreSQL `SELECT` queries, executes them via an MCP tool `query_civitai_db` (served by an external HTTP MCP server in `.mcp.json`), and formats results into insights and JSON/HTML weekly reports.

## What I observed
- **All bundled SQL is read-only.** The 7 query templates plus the one I generated are pure `SELECT` statements — no `INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DROP/ALTER/TRUNCATE/CREATE/GRANT`. The skill's prompt is data-analysis oriented and contains **no instruction to ignore rules, exfiltrate data, or run remote scripts**.
- **Execution path is unavailable here (by design):** the MCP tool `query_civitai_db` is not registered in this session, and `CIVITAI_RECORD_MCP_SERVER_TOKEN` is not set. No real query could (or should) run.
- **One external endpoint:** `.mcp.json` points at a third-party n8n webhook on an AWS IP (`18.191.220.185`, via sslip.io). I did a **credential-free HEAD probe** (no Authorization header, no query body) purely for reachability — it returned HTTP 200. No secret or data was transmitted.
